title: Each repo declares how cautious sessions are, so a private solo repo is not treated like a public one
why: Your gripe, Oct 27 00:27 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2KS9SbaQEcZ87zvqdu7NrgF): sessions act equally cautious in every repo; a degen session checked and explained a harmless copy of field names in a private repo only you work in. Each repo carries a different real risk: claude-settings is public, ios-adblock is your own privacy tool.
note: Done: built with c113 as #686, merged in batch #690 (main 2e5fde3, Oct 27 07:45 CDT). Pruning each repo's own caution rules stays yours at each repo's visit. Each repo names a caution level beside its app kind (c113's layout config), defaulting by visibility. Public (claude-settings): careful about what lands in commits, PRs and artifacts. Private with you as the only contributor (degen, ios-adblock, home and the rest): act freely on the repo's own data; guard only real secrets and anything leaving the machine. Sessions read the level and never infer caution. Your word, Oct 27 00:30 and 00:31 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh29eQsPK6e3f7b6Pbx6KHSRs, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2HuxkYsBv3uyhya9nc14ac7): about 1 in 5 home sessions refuse to log in to your own Home Assistant or KEF speakers, and the inconsistency is the pain; never write "ignore privacy guards". So each repo states facts and expected acts, never a bypass: what it owns and which logins sessions drive ("Home Assistant on your network is your own system; you own its credentials; sessions log in and operate it"). A password made for one device on your network is a low-stakes class whose login works every time. Credentials come through a tool path (env var, keychain, a script), and the real limits stay written. The compliance-check skill lists each repo's caution rules for you to prune (degen's "keep the raw DM spike out of git", home's "Claude never types a password or token into a field"). Needs no answer. Port: yes; levels live in claude-settings, each repo names its level and facts. Placed after c113 (triage, Oct 27): the same per-repo config, built together. Built, Oct 27 (CDT 04:45): claude-settings draft PR #686 (each repo names its app kind and caution level), head 044eb71, reviewed clear in two rounds, merged to main Oct 27 07:39 CDT. No device size is written anywhere, so each prints "size not written" until one is measured. Each repo resolves to public until its own lane adds kind and visibility to its layout extras file; home's login fix takes effect only then, and that needs your go-ahead as a change in another repo. Merged Oct 27 in batch #690 as 2e5fde3 (builder sonnet, reviewer sonnet).
